JK-000001.artist_bio_en: Zen master, healer and ink painting master from Taiwan. Born in 1957, he awakened at the age of 36. Traveled annually through Europe, Russia, Canada and Goa, conducting acupuncture sessions and Zen gatherings. Passed away on November 10, 2017 at his forest center in Taiwan.

JK-000003.artist_bio_en: Vova Perkin is a Moscow-based artist working at the intersection of street art, comics and painting. His works are recognizable by their bold contrasting colors, sharp silhouettes and grotesque characters balancing between fairy tale and surrealism. He draws on Russian literature and mythology, reinterpreting them through irony and decorative graphics. His work has been shown in leading Russian galleries.
